name: Lower A
notes: First run of the rebuilt leg day: jump work and tibialis raises in front, core inside the rest periods, hip thrust added. Left-right asymmetry found on the split squat: right side handled 8 kg per hand, the left gave way, so he dropped to bodyweight himself. He also reports landing to the right off box jumps and standing to the right on deadlifts. Abs went from 0 to 3 hard sets for the week. Hamstring work fell off the end again: he mistook the leg extension for the leg curl and did no leg curl, then asked for more posterior chain focus next leg day.
